measurement_plan.design: Paired same cases, index, model, prompts, hardware and gates; alternating or randomized order
measurement_plan.retrieval: Sequential vs concurrent first-stage wall time, warm and cold separately
measurement_plan.cache: Bypass vs populated exact-authority cache; include misses, lookup costs and actual hit rate
measurement_plan.stream: Buffered vs verified events: first useful verified block and complete answer separately
measurement_plan.sample_size: 30 pairs pilot; at least100 pairs for more useful tail estimates, then check uncertainty
measurement_plan.report: p50/p95 plus paired reduction uncertainty, success/gate outcomes, provider active time, admission waits and cold starts separately
measurement_plan.claim_rule: Benefit must exceed measurement uncertainty with no safety or correctness regression; arithmetic removal of waits is not a new observation
